진주는 자란 만큼 받아요. 끝까지 키우면 더 받고, 거기서부터 사냥 시간: You earn pearls for how much you grow. Grow all the way for extra, and hunting time starts from there. Spend pearls to level a fish up (max 10) so it grows faster and earns more. The deeper you go the darker and more dangerous it gets, but the more pearls you find. Reach 25 and 60 hunts for stars and gems. The bigger you get, the slower you move and the less nimbly you turn. Pricier fish hold their skill a little longer and reuse it sooner. Max sizes are roughly the real species' maximum length.
